demos.title: Kaleidoscope
demos.summary: Sixty drifting shapes folded into a pattern that never repeats. Move the mouse to move its middle; tap for more segments.

demos.title: Tunnel
demos.summary: Five small stars and one line of trails make a tunnel of colour you fall through for ever. Move the mouse to steer.

demos.title: Neon Sign
demos.summary: Words drawn as plain outlines, and a glow that turns them into a sign in a dark street. One letter has a loose wire.

demos.title: Lava Lamp
demos.summary: Nothing is drawn at all: the blobs are a backdrop the graphics card makes by itself. Four lines of effects.

demos.title: Arcade
demos.summary: The screen an arcade machine shows while it waits for a coin, on the curved glass of an old television.

demos.title: Visualiser
demos.summary: A tune in four lines and a picture that moves to it: the bass swells the glow, each beat kicks the trails outward.

demos.title: Finger Paint
demos.summary: Draw with a finger or the mouse. Whatever you draw is mirrored four ways and glows, and slowly fades.

demos.title: Glitch Title
demos.summary: The title of a film taped off the television long ago: colour bars, big words and a tape that keeps slipping.
